title: Bot
copyFailed: Could not copy automatically — copy the value from the field by hand.

notConnected.title: Bot not connected
notConnected.hint: No key has been issued for the bot yet. A superadmin creates the first key on the Status tab.

errors.tooMany: Too often, try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.invalid: The server did not accept the values. Check the fields and try again.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible right now. Refresh the page and check the state.

reasons.no_telegram: This person has no Telegram linked.
reasons.bot_blocked: The person has blocked the bot — the message will not reach them.
reasons.not_configured: The public address of the panel is not set, so a config link cannot be built. Set the address in the panel settings.
reasons.no_access: This person has no active access to a server.
reasons.config_unavailable: A config link cannot be issued for this access: for example, the client was picked up from AmneziaVPN.
reasons.no_default_protocol: No protocol chosen: choose one in the form or set a default protocol in the Settings tab.
reasons.not_failed: This registration is no longer in error.
reasons.already_finished: The broadcast is already finished or cancelled.
reasons.not_linked: Link Telegram under My notifications first.

html.tag: Unsupported tag. Allowed: b, i, u, s, code, pre, blockquote, a and tg-spoiler.
html.attr: Unsupported tag attribute. A link takes only href with an http or https address.
html.entity: Write the signs "<" and "&" in the text as < and &; Telegram knows no other named entities.
html.nesting: Tags are nested wrongly: close each one, in reverse order. A link inside a link and a quote inside a quote are not allowed.
html.length: The visible text is longer than 4096 characters. An emoji counts as two.
html.empty: There is nothing in the text but markup.

status.title: Status
status.stale: The bot has not been in touch for a long time. Check that it is running.
status.queueStuck: The bot is not taking the queue (update the bot): messages are waiting to be sent.

revoke.title: Revoke the key "{{name}}"?
revoke.consequences: The bot stops working at once: its requests to the panel will be rejected. A key cannot be restored — you need a new one.

create.title: New bot key
create.description: The key is the bot's password to the panel. Give it a name you will recognise later.
create.doneDescription: Copy the key and paste it into the bot settings. Once the window is closed it cannot be shown again.
create.name: Name

delete.title: Delete key “{{name}}”?
delete.consequences: The revoked key will be removed from the list. Audit history is retained.

create.title: New invite
create.description: The person opens the bot by the link and gets access for the chosen period.
create.onceLink: The link is shown once: after the window is closed it cannot be retrieved, and the list does not have it. Send it to the person.
create.onceCode: The code is shown once. The bot name is not known yet (the bot has not been in touch), so there is no ready link: send the code to the person and ask them to open the bot and send it /start with this code.
create.onceBatch: Copy all links or codes now: they cannot be displayed again after closing this window.

delete.title: Delete invite?
delete.consequences: The revoked unused invite will be deleted. Audit history is retained.

settings.title: Settings
settings.daysHint: How many days of access a person gets when the invite names no period.
settings.validDaysHint: After how many days an unaccepted invite expires.
settings.panelDownHint: From 1 to 1440 minutes. A bot on the same server as the panel cannot report that server going down.
settings.invalid: Check the values: the outage threshold must be from 1 to 1440 minutes, with whole-second precision.

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.textHint: Telegram HTML: b, i, u, s, code, pre, blockquote, a href, tg-spoiler. Write the signs "<" and "&" as < and &.
broadcasts.searchHint: Start typing a name or a nickname.
broadcasts.audienceNote: Will not get it: without Telegram — {{withoutTelegram}}, blocked the bot — {{blocked}}.

confirm.title: Send the broadcast?
confirm.news: What is sent cannot be taken back: cancelling stops only what has not gone yet.
confirm.config: The previous links of the recipients will stop working: everyone gets a new link to their config.

notify.title: My notifications
notify.linkHint: Open the bot using the link or send /admin followed by this code. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
notify.expired: The code has expired. Close this window and request a new one.
notify.deliveryFailed: Message was not delivered. Check your Telegram link and the bot status.
notify.unlinkConsequences: You will stop receiving notifications. You can link Telegram again.
notify.updateBot: Update the bot: this version does not support notifications.
notify.localBot: The bot runs on the same server as the panel and cannot report this server going down.
notify.blocked: You blocked the bot. Unblock it in Telegram and link it again.
